items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: I know Steve, yes, Steve Lewis.

ctx.x: I know Steve, yes, Steve Lewis. Did you like his playing? Well of course he played a style that was quite popular at that time when I heard it. You see they had ragtime piano plays at that time and this music like Swinging Down the Lane and those tunes of course, they were not so popular around there we played them on the boat but of course they were not so popular around the city. I had Swinging Down the Lane and Lord's Nest and let me see here, and another tune that we used to play on the boat that, well those…
